info.name: Order Management System API
info.description:
REST API of the Order Management System (Laravel 13, `/api/v1`).

**Start:** run `composer run dev`, then **Auth → Get CSRF cookie** and **Auth → Login** (demo admin from the seeder). Or run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner / `npx newman run docs/postman/OMS.postman_collection.json`: requests save the ids they create into collection variables for the next ones.

**Auth:** Sanctum SPA cookie sessions. Collection scripts send `Accept: application/json`, a `Referer` from `baseUrl`, and copy the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie into `X-XSRF-TOKEN`.

**Responses:** `{ success, message, data, meta? }`. Errors: `{ success: false, message, errors? }` with 401 (not logged in), 403 (no permission), 404, 409 (version conflict), 419 (CSRF), 422 (validation or business rule), 429 (too many attempts).

**Money** is integer cents (`36300` = $363.00) with `*_formatted` strings; tax rates are basis points (`1000` = 10%).

Examples are real responses from the seeded demo data; list examples are shortened to two items. Full overview: `docs/API.md`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sanctum SPA cookie auth. Run **Get CSRF cookie** first, then **Login**. The collection scripts copy the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie into the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and send a `Referer` from `baseUrl` on every request, which Sanctum needs to treat the request as stateful. The session cookie then authenticates the following requests.

request.description:
Sets the `XSRF-TOKEN` and session cookies. Returns 204.

**Auth:** Public

Starts a session. Wrong credentials and deactivated accounts get the same 422 message.

**Auth:** Public (throttled: 5 attempts/min per email + IP)
